## Closing the gaps between AI agents and production

### Kubernetes as a first-class agentic runtime

kagent natively extends Kubernetes to support agents, tools, and skills as first-class entities, with the identity, policy, sandboxing, and observability controls production demands.

### One gateway for every agentic protocol

Prior-generation proxies weren't built for agentic protocols. agentgateway was, from the ground up, with full MCP and A2A implementation. Model aliasing, token-weighted rate limiting, intelligent routing. One gateway, not three layered on top of each other.

### Control that doesn't slow teams down

Developers pick the framework, the model, the tool. Control moves to the platform layer. MCP server provenance checks, approved-catalog workflows, end-to-end tracing, centralized policy. Teams move fast. Nothing runs unchecked.

## Our commitment to the open source community

Our support for the open-source landscape runs deep, from our donation of projects like kagent and agentgateway to our recognition as a top 10 CNCF contributor.
